attachment_assets_scope_ck.name: attachment_assets_scope_ck
attachment_assets_scope_ck.value: ("attachment_assets"."kind" = 'message' and "attachment_assets"."workspace_id" is not null) or ("attachment_assets"."kind" = 'logo' and "attachment_assets"."uploader_user_id" is not null and "attachment_assets"."visitor_ref" is null)

conversations_spam_state_ck.name: conversations_spam_state_ck
conversations_spam_state_ck.value: ("conversations"."is_spam" = true and "conversations"."spam_marked_at" is not null) or ("conversations"."is_spam" = false and "conversations"."spam_marked_at" is null)

member_notifications_target_ck.name: member_notifications_target_ck
member_notifications_target_ck.value:
("member_notifications"."type" = 'assignment' and "member_notifications"."source" = 'conversation' and "member_notifications"."conversation_id" is not null and "member_notifications"."message_id" is null and "member_notifications"."team_message_id" is null)
      or ("member_notifications"."type" = 'mention' and "member_notifications"."source" = 'conversation' and "member_notifications"."conversation_id" is not null and "member_notifications"."message_id" is not null and "member_notifications"."team_message_id" is null)
      or ("member_notifications"."type" = 'mention' and "member_notifications"."source" = 'nest' and "member_notifications"."conversation_id" is null and "member_notifications"."message_id" is null and "member_notifications"."team_message_id" is not null)

support_outcome_events_payload_ck.name: support_outcome_events_payload_ck
support_outcome_events_payload_ck.value: ("support_outcome_events"."event_type" = 'resolution' and "support_outcome_events"."request_id" is null and "support_outcome_events"."rating" is null) or ("support_outcome_events"."event_type" = 'csat' and "support_outcome_events"."request_id" is not null and "support_outcome_events"."rating" in ('good', 'bad'))

visitor_blocks_unblocked_state_ck.name: visitor_blocks_unblocked_state_ck
visitor_blocks_unblocked_state_ck.value: "visitor_blocks"."unblocked_at" is not null or "visitor_blocks"."unblocked_by_member_id" is null

widget_intro.name: widget_intro
widget_intro.default: 'Tell us a bit about you and how we can help.'

widget_offline_message.name: widget_offline_message
widget_offline_message.default: 'We’re away right now, but leave a message and we’ll get back to you.'
